statements.statement: The patient presents with intermittent palpitations and a sensation of irregular heartbeat
These findings are concerning for arrhythmia
The patient has known nonrheumatic mitral valve insufficiency (I34.0)
Continuous ambulatory rhythm data over an extended monitoring period is required to correlate the patient's symptoms with potential cardiac events
This cannot be accomplished by a shorter recording
The service was denied with reason code CO-50
The clinical documentation provided did not sufficiently establish the requirement for continuous ambulatory monitoring over the specified period
